description: Documentation schema for benchmark task manifests. The Python task registry performs lightweight stdlib validation against this shape.

fields.id: Stable task id. Must match the containing directory name.
fields.name: Human-readable task name.
fields.summary: One-paragraph description of the task contract.
fields.stage: Episode stage label returned by runtime APIs.
fields.suite_stage: Suite stage label returned by suite APIs.
fields.runtime: Runtime family used by the task.
fields.readiness: Task readiness, such as scored or experimental.
fields.observation_sources: Normalized observation sources expected by the task.
fields.required_conformance: Conformance check ids that must pass before scored runs.
fields.scoring: Score dimensions used by summaries and suite aggregation.
fields.artifact_groups: Expected remote artifact files or directories under the run episode directory.

boundary_rules.action_types: Use benchmark action type names only. Raw OCUDU wire commands such as rrm_policy_ratio_set, ssb_set, and metrics_subscribe are not task action types.
boundary_rules.artifact_groups: Use relative episode artifact paths only, such as episode/summary.json or episode/logs.
